name: Highland Village Plaza -
demographics: Highland Village Plaza serves a diverse, working-class to middle-income demographic in the Inland Empire region of Southern California. The primary trade area draws families and value-conscious shoppers from Highland and surrounding San Bernardino County communities, with a mix of Hispanic, White, and African American households. Typical visitors are budget-minded consumers seeking everyday necessities, with shopping patterns centered around grocery runs and essential services rather than discretionary retail spending.
description: Highland Village Plaza is a neighborhood shopping center located at 7219 Boulder Avenue in Highland, California, serving the local community with convenient access to everyday essentials and services. Anchored by Food 4 Less, a popular discount grocery chain, the plaza caters to value-conscious shoppers throughout the San Bernardino County area. The center has earned a solid 4.2-star rating from nearly 400 Google reviews, with visitors praising specific tenants like the kung fu pho restaurant that serves excellent seafood pho and wings, as well as a highly-regarded veterinary clinic that customers describe as the "best vet around" with wonderful employees. While some reviewers note that the walkways could use better maintenance, the plaza's tenants consistently deliver great service and value to the community. Operating daily from 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM, Highland Village Plaza provides Highland residents with a reliable destination for groceries, dining, pet care, and other neighborhood services in a convenient strip center format.
summary: Highland Village Plaza is a community-oriented shopping center in Highland, California, anchored by Food 4 Less and featuring popular local businesses including a Vietnamese restaurant and veterinary clinic. With a 4.2-star rating and nearly 400 reviews, the plaza serves as a convenient neighborhood destination for everyday shopping and services.
